exports.name: ClipboardComponent
exports.summary: Internal tooltip shown by {@link ClipboardDirective} while hovering over a copyable element.
exports.summaryZh: {@link ClipboardDirective} 在悬停可复制元素时显示的内部提示气泡。

exports.name: ClipboardDirective
exports.summary: Attach to any element to copy its associated text/content to the clipboard on click.
exports.summaryZh: 附加到任意元素上，点击时将关联的文本/内容复制到剪贴板。

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Tooltip text shown on hover before copying.
inputs.descriptionZh: 悬停时显示的提示文字。

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Reference to the HTML element containing the text to copy.
inputs.descriptionZh: 包含待复制文本的 HTML 元素引用。

inputs.name: message
inputs.description: Toast message shown after a successful copy.
inputs.descriptionZh: 复制成功后显示的提示消息。

exports.name: ClipboardService
exports.summary:
Copies text from an input/textarea element, or arbitrary content, to the system clipboard.
Optionally shows a toast notification (via {@link ToastrService}) on success.
exports.summaryZh: 将输入框/文本域中的文本，或任意内容，复制到系统剪贴板。可选地在复制成功后显示提示（通过 {@link ToastrService}）。

methods.name: isTargetValid
methods.description: Checks whether the given element can be copied from (must be an enabled input/textarea).
methods.descriptionZh: 判断目标元素是否可以被复制（必须是未禁用的 input/textarea）。

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Selects the full text of an input/textarea element and copies it to the clipboard.
methods.descriptionZh: 选中 input/textarea 元素的全部文本并复制到剪贴板。

methods.name: copyContentToClipboard
methods.description:
Copies arbitrary content (string or object, which is JSON-stringified) to the clipboard,
without requiring a source input/textarea element.
methods.descriptionZh: 将任意内容（字符串或对象，对象会被 JSON 序列化）复制到剪贴板，无需依赖某个 input/textarea 元素。

exports.name: CopyButtonComponent
exports.summary:
A ready-made icon button that copies a given string to the clipboard when clicked,
showing a brief "copied" tooltip state.
exports.summaryZh: 一个开箱即用的图标按钮，点击后将指定字符串复制到剪贴板，并短暂显示"已复制"提示状态。

inputs.name: copyText
inputs.description: The text to copy to the clipboard.
inputs.descriptionZh: 要复制到剪贴板的文本。

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: Icon name shown on the button.
inputs.descriptionZh: 按钮上显示的图标名称。

inputs.name: tooltipText
inputs.descriptionZh: 复制前显示的提示文字。

inputs.name: tooltipPosition
inputs.descriptionZh: 提示气泡的位置（沿用 Angular Material 的 `TooltipPosition`）。

inputs.name: style
inputs.description: Inline style object applied to the button.
inputs.descriptionZh: 应用到按钮上的内联样式对象。

inputs.name: miniButton
inputs.description: Renders as a compact (mini) icon button.
inputs.descriptionZh: 是否渲染为紧凑（迷你）图标按钮。

outputs.name: successCopied
outputs.description: Emits the copied text after a successful copy.
outputs.descriptionZh: 复制成功后，发出被复制的文本。
